explanation: Copper comes a close second and costs far less, which is why it fills our electrical wires. Gold is used on connectors because it resists corrosion.

claims.text: At room temperature, silver has the highest electrical conductivity of any metal.
Copper, gold and aluminium all conduct electricity less well than silver, with copper second.
Copper is much cheaper than silver and is the usual metal in electrical wiring.
Gold is used to coat electrical connectors because it resists corrosion.
